subject: [PATCH v3 7/7] mm: use VMA flag helpers in NUMA balancing

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch updates the NUMA balancing code in the Linux kernel to use VMA flag helpers instead of directly accessing vm_flags. The changes are made in three files: kernel/sched/fair.c, mm/internal.h, and mm/migrate.c. The patch does not introduce any functional changes but rather simplifies the code by using the vma_test() function to check for specific flags. This change is intended to make the code more maintainable and easier to understand.
